ask_safety_override_complete.name: ask_safety_override_complete
ask_safety_override_complete.value: ("ask"."safety_override_at" IS NULL AND "ask"."safety_override_by" IS NULL AND "ask"."safety_override_reason" IS NULL) OR ("ask"."safety_override_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ask"."safety_override_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ask"."safety_override_reason" IS NOT NULL)

ask_close_note_complete.name: ask_close_note_complete
ask_close_note_complete.value: ("ask"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "ask"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "ask"."close_note" IS NULL) OR ("ask"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ask"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ask"."close_note" IS NOT NULL)

slot_window_ordered.name: slot_window_ordered
slot_window_ordered.value: "slot"."window_start" IS NULL OR "slot"."window_end" IS NULL OR "slot"."window_end" > "slot"."window_start"

slot_auto_publish_low_risk_only.name: slot_auto_publish_low_risk_only
slot_auto_publish_low_risk_only.value: "slot"."published_via" <> 'auto_low_risk' OR ("slot"."kind" IN ('meal', 'errand') AND "slot"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "slot"."approved_by" IS NULL)
